note: A finger permutation that sends fingers 2 and 3 one after the other, so each learns to move alone. The old tempo ladder (a Stage selector of 70, 80 and 90) is now moves (70 to 90 bpm): the app brings the faster tempo once the drill was easy, so the text names the tempo as a param and no selector. The tab shows the frets, so the text names only the finger order and the feel to reach.

exercise.title: Fingers 1, 3, 2, 4
exercise.why: Fingers 2 and 3 like to move together, so a pattern that sends them one after the other in the wrong order teaches each to move alone.

cells.text:
Press Play below to start the metronome at {{=bpm}}: the drill sounds with it, one note per beat, and the note playing is lit on the tab. On each string play the four frets with one finger each, in the order 1, 3, 2 and 4, and move through every string as the tab shows. The row under the tab shows the pick stroke for each note.
Stay with it until the order needs no thought and fingers 2 and 3 land one after the other, never together.
